text: They say the town roundabout is shy. Go easy on it.
The market smells of bread and old socks.
A grey cat watches traffic like a mayor.
The bakery sends warm crumbs to my window.
School cars wave like friendly ducks in a row.
The fountain splashes like it has bad manners.
The post box is always waiting for letters.
A lamp post hums a tune about Tuesday.
A neighbour waves her watering can at passing cars.
The hills look like they were cut from paper.
Visit Wobble Bumper! We polish your car with polite fluff.
Tidy Tyre Tea Rooms gives your wheels a biscuit.
Fender Friends mends dents and tells them sorry.
The Loo Loop offers clean rest breaks and tiny cakes.
Sunny Socks Suits sell hats for happy headlights.
Bumper Biscuits Bakery bakes cookies shaped like road signs.
Glow Garden Gifts wraps presents with twinkly moss.
Happy Horns teaches your car to say hello gently.
Clouds are drifting like sleepy ducks.
The wind wants a gentle hug.
Sun is peeking behind a hill.
Fog will tiptoe through town soon.
Bright skies are on their way.
The moon smiles tonight.
The night has bright stars.
The dark is soft and quiet.
The evening hums a little tune.
The night says hello gently.
The rain taps on roofs.
The wet roads shine like ribbons.
An umbrella dances in the rain.
A tiny drizzle tickles windows.
A puddle holds a tiny moon.
Nice work, driver, you made it!
That delivery was lovely!
You turned a hard trip smooth!
Well done, town waves hello.
Another happy job, hooray!
No job this time, but the road still likes you.
Shake it off, friend. Another lovely drive is coming.
The parcel missed you, but you are still a star.
No rush, no fuss. You did well to try.
We lost that parcel, but the lanes will teach us.
Your tank is yawning. A little sip would help.
The pump is humming, but your tank is quiet.
Your tank needs a fill; please visit the pump.
Your petrol is shy. Please visit the friendly pump.
Don't fuss, but the fuel is getting sleepy.
A little fuel would keep this little town moving.
You are on a roll, and the town is smiling.
Another job, another smile. Keep that lovely streak going.
What a row! The streetlights are clapping for you.
Great shift! The little town waves its flags.
Keep going, star driver. You are lovely and steady.
